ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of a rare early‑1967 blues‑heavy Dead show, with Jerry Garcia and Pigpen delivering standout performances.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as a high‑quality capture that lets the raw, blues‑infused energy of this early‑'67 set shine through. Reviewers highlight Jerry’s guitar work and Pigpen’s organ/vocals, noting the show’s organic feel and its appeal to roots‑rock fans. No technical flaws are reported, making it both a musical and archival gem.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently positive reviews (5×) emphasize strong performance and good recording quality; weighting favors the show, yielding a solid above‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the tape as high‑quality with no noted dropouts or muddiness; the soundboard source provides clear, balanced audio.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑1967 set focused on blues, R&B and emerging psychedelic material; the flow feels organic and raw, appealing to roots‑rock listeners.
